name: GitHub
approach: Useful README, working quickstart, example project and release notes
measure: Repository traffic plus downstream successful installs/use
risk: Stars can come from curiosity; rolling traffic history is short
complexity: Low; public metrics or repository-scoped read token
maintainability: Keep examples tested and collect traffic weekly

name: Show HN
approach: Tryable substantive project, maker explanation and thoughtful replies
measure: Thread feedback and tagged product activation
risk: One-off generated projects and signup-only pages may be ineligible
complexity: Low setup; launch timing and discussion are unpredictable
maintainability: Be available for support; no repeated routine version posts

name: YouTube
approach: Show the payoff or a useful tutorial with a directly tryable next step
measure: Engaged viewing, tagged visits, successful first use and return
risk: Public playback starts can look impressive without product interest
complexity: Moderate production; definitions and reporting delay matter
maintainability: Batch footage; keep one reusable demonstration format

name: TikTok
approach: Show the real payoff in the first seconds as a short vertical video, with one tryable next step in the profile link or caption
measure: Video views at 100% and average play time by video length, tagged profile-link visits, first use and return
risk: Views measure attention, not first use or payment; promotional posts need the content disclosure setting; engagement tricks and bulk automation break integrity rules
complexity: Moderate: vertical production and in-app analytics that differ from the ads-side definitions
maintainability: Batch clips from real play or use; no automation, bought engagement or reposting bots

name: Relevant Reddit communities
approach: Inspect community rules; contribute a useful native explanation where promotion is welcome
measure: Objections, tagged use and return from the specific community
risk: Repetitive promotion can be spam; no blanket posting allowance
maintainability: Build relationships; do not run a promotional bot

name: itch.io and game communities
approach: Playable demo, genre-readable screenshots and a brief development log
measure: Qualified plays, completion and returning players
risk: Audience and device fit may differ from your intended players
complexity: Moderate asset preparation and distribution setup
maintainability: Maintain the playable build and respond to bug reports

name: Search and useful documentation
approach: Answer a real recurring question with a useful page and a working example
measure: Qualified search visits and successful use
risk: Slow feedback; ranking is not guaranteed
complexity: Instrumentation, indexable pages and topic judgment
maintainability: Update examples and monitor query intent

name: Opt-in email
approach: Useful update to people who opted in; one clear next action
measure: Tagged successful use and unsubscribes; treat opens cautiously
risk: A small list limits discovery; unwanted mail harms trust
maintainability: Keep the cadence sustainable and honor unsubscribes

name: Existing Discord community
approach: Share useful progress and invite focused feedback in a relevant existing community
measure: Playtest participation, recurring use and qualitative themes
risk: Starting a new empty server creates moderation work before demand
maintainability: Only open your own community when you can sustain it

name: LinkedIn
approach: Concrete before/after workflow for the professional audience
risk: Impressions and generic praise can be weak demand signals
complexity: Requires clear professional relevance and a credible demo
maintainability: Reuse actual user stories with permission

name: Product Hunt
cost: 0 for a basic launch; verify current terms
approach: Prepared maker launch with concise gallery, demo and available support
risk: Launch-day rank is not durable demand; do not solicit upvotes
maintainability: Plan support and a follow-up beyond launch day
